convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iMACD indicator. Simple entry/exit rules with MACD line comparisons. Fixed percentage position sizing. Trade library includes (PositionInfo.mqh, Trade.mqh, etc.) are standard MT5 shipping libraries for order execution, not custom trading logic.

derived_values.name: ExtTrailing - digit-adjusted trailing stop in points
derived_values.formula: InpTrailing * digits_adjust (digits_adjust=10 if Digits==3 or 5, else 1)

derived_values.name: ExtLot - optimized lot size from free margin

long.left: MACD_MAIN[3] > MACD_SIGNAL[3] && MACD_MAIN[2] > MACD_SIGNAL[2] && MACD_MAIN[1] < MACD_SIGNAL[1] && MACD_MAIN[2] > MACD_MAIN[3] && MACD_MAIN[1] < MACD_MAIN[2] && MACD_MAIN[0] > MACD_MAIN[1]

short.left: MACD_MAIN[3] < MACD_SIGNAL[3] && MACD_MAIN[2] < MACD_SIGNAL[2] && MACD_MAIN[1] > MACD_SIGNAL[1] && MACD_MAIN[2] < MACD_MAIN[3] && MACD_MAIN[1] > MACD_MAIN[2] && MACD_MAIN[0] < MACD_MAIN[1]

other_exits: BUY closed when MACD MAIN[0] < MACD MAIN[1] (main line declining)
SELL closed when MACD MAIN[0] > MACD MAIN[1] (main line rising)
Trailing stop modification has a minimum pause of 255 seconds between modifications

position_sizing.conditional_logic: ExtLot = NormalizeDouble(FreeMargin * Risk / 100, 1); then adjusted by LotCheck to respect volume step, min, and max

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses a 3-bar MACD crossover pattern with absolute threshold filters: BUY requires MACD main line to have crossed below signal 1 bar ago (after being above for 2 bars), with MACD_MAIN[1] < -0.00020, MACD_MAIN[2] < 0, and MACD_MAIN[0] > 0.00020. SELL requires the inverse with asymmetric threshold (MACD_MAIN[0] < -0.00035 vs > 0.00020 for buy). The trailing stop only activates after price moves ExtTrailing points beyond entry, and modifications are throttled by a 255-second pause. Position gate is no_position: EA only opens new trades when total_positions==0 for the symbol+magic. BUY entries at Bid price, SELL entries at Ask price (non-standard). No SL/TP set on entry (both passed as 0).
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Built-in MACD with params 5/15/3 on close price. Entry logic uses bar indices [0],[1],[2],[3] of MACD main and signal lines - must preserve the 4-bar lookback pattern exactly. Absolute threshold values (-0.00020, 0.00020, -0.00035) are hardcoded for EURUSD 5-digit; these need symbol-aware adjustment or parameterization for other instruments. Trailing stop is point-based with digit adjustment (multiply by 10 for 5-digit). Position sizing uses FreeMargin * Risk / 100 rounded to 1 decimal, then clamped by volume step/min/max - replicate LotCheck logic. The 255-second modification pause is a simple timestamp guard. No new-bar check means signal is evaluated every tick; for H1 backtesting with bar data, evaluate signal on bar close only.
